basis: The corrected September 1 taxonomy supplies classifications for its covered debates. Explicit entries also resolve the 16 legacy panels omitted from that taxonomy. Positions follow the published proposition and side labels, not personal religious identity; chart eligibility additionally requires compatible locked argument records.
